name: Inertia Horizontal Film Pan
description: Build a horizontal timeline strip showcasing film project frames using CSS subgrid and translate3d transforms. Synchronize progress with native scroll timelines without using wheel event preventDefault or fake smooth-scrolling hijackers, ensuring trackpads, mouse wheels, and mobile touch gestures remain completely natural.
designPhilosophy: Build a horizontal timeline strip showcasing film project frames using CSS subgrid and translate3d transforms
implementationApproach: Target rock-solid 60 FPS performance and less than 5MB initial asset delivery.
performanceConsiderations: Utilize translate3d, will-change sparingly, and clamp animation timelines under 600ms.
accessibilityRequirements: Provide prefers-reduced-motion override and ensure WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard focus visibility.
